sentences.text:
1 2. The brief facts of the prosecution case are as follow:-
The accused borrowed amount to the tune of Rs.4,60,286/- from the complainant from the year 2021 to 2023 promising to pay the same in EMI's and the accused had no intention to pay the amount and he has not paid any EMI with an intention to cheat the complainant and further on 13.09.2025 at 4th Cross, Venkateshwara Layout when the complainant asked the accused to pay the EMI, the accused has threatened the complainant with dire consequences.
On the first information given by the CW1, FIR came to be registered and after completion of investigation, charge sheet came to be filed against the accused for the above said offences.
3. After taking cognizance, this court has complied Section 207 of Cr.P.C. by supplying charge sheet materials to the accused.
The Charges read over and explained to the accused and he has not pleaded guilty of alleged offences and claimed to be tried.

4. The Prosecution in order to prove the case, examined the P.W.1 and got marked Ex.P1 and 2.
5. The 313 Statement of accused dispensed with for having not found any incriminating materials against him.
6. I heard learned APP and learned counsel appearing for the accused.
7.

The points that arose for my consideration are:
:: P O I N T S ::
Point No.1 : Whether the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubt that, the accused borrowed amount to the tune of Rs.4,60,286/- from the complainant from the year 2021 to 2023 promising to pay the same in EMI's and the accused had no intention to pay the amount and he has not paid any EMI with an intention to cheat the complainant and there by committed offence punishable under section 420 of IPC?
Point No.2.

Whether the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubt that, further on 13.09.2025 at 4 th Cross, Venkateshwara Layout when the complainant asked the accused to pay the EMI, the accused has threatened the complainant with dire consequences and thereby the accused has committed offence punishable under section 506 of IPC?
Point No.3. What order?
8. After going through the records and hearing the learned APP and learned counsel for the accused.

I answer the above points as under :

sentences.text: Point No.1 & 2 :
In the Negative Point No.3 : As per final order, for the following:
REASONS 9. Point No.1 & 2 : As the facts involved in these points are common, in order to avoid repetition of facts, they are taken together for consideration.

10. The prosecution in order to prove its case has examined the complainant as PW1 and got marked complaint at Ex.P1, panchanama at Ex.P2.
11.

The prosecution in order to prove the case has examined the complainant as P.W1 and PW1 in her evidence she has deposed that, she knows the accused but she does not know the contents of complaint and panchanama and there was only altercation between the complainant and accused and further deposed that, accused has repaid all the amount and he has not committed any offences against her and she is treated as hostile witness and she was cross-examined by the learned App by suggesting that, on 13.09.2025, the accused threatened the complainant with dire consequences when she asked the money which she has given to him from the year 2021 to 2023 and therefore she has given complaint as per Ex.P1 against the accused for cheating and for criminal intimidation and police have conducted the panchanama in the place shown by her as per Ex.P2.
But all these suggestions were denied by PW1 and nothing worthy was elicited in the course of the cross-examination in favour of the prosecution.
12. The complainant who is the material witness and herself has not at all supported the prosecution case and she has clearly stated that, she has compromised the matter with the accused.

The alleged offences are compoundable in nature and therefore as there are no incriminating materials found against the accused, 313 statement of the accused dispensed with for having not found any incriminating materials against the accused.
Hence accused is entitled for the benefit of doubt and he is entitled to be Acquitted.
Hence, with the above observations, I hold point No.1 in the NEGATIVE.
13. Point No.2

: For the reasons stated and discussion made above, I proceed to pass the following ;
ORDER
The accused is ACQUITTED U/s 248(1) of Cr.P.C. for the offences punishable U/s 420 and 506 of IPC.
[ The bail bonds executed by accused shall be continued for a period of six months.
(Dictated to the stenographer, transcribed and computerized by her, corrected and then pronounced by me in the open court on this the 07 th day of November, 2025).
(MANJUNATH D.R.) C/c CJM., Bengaluru City.
